Checks that a Change introduces no new personal-data egress from checkout.
Reviews the diff and runtime evidence of a Change Request for new personal-data
flows out of the checkout plane, and reports findings bound to the exact revision.

g.text: card_trigger_01 · apiVersion wyrd/v1 · read-only projection of server truth
Fires the drift investigation Operator when the ranker's PSI report breaches its threshold.
plain language first, exact configuration after
Every 10 minutes, read new model-drift observations for checkout-api; when a
calculated report breaches its 0.20 threshold, fire investigate-ranking-drift.
